user.title: DEFCON Home sources
user.description: Select the Home Assistant entities that should contribute to the household situation level. NINA warnings, DWD warning-level sensors and HVV status entities are evaluated differently.

data_description.nina_entities: Select the NINA binary warning slots for the area you want to monitor.
data_description.dwd_entities: Select current and/or advance DWD warning-level sensors.
data_description.hvv_entities: Select only the HVV entities relevant to your household routes.
data_description.other_entities: Optional generic binary sensors or status sensors. Active problems raise DEFCON 4.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one DEFCON Home instance can be configured.
